name: Call of Duty: World at War (Plutonium Mod)

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode. Configure the relevant config file accordingly - 'T4/main/server.cfg' for Multiplayer, 'T4/main/server_zm.cfg' for Zombies

configurationFields.label: Server Key
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server key](https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys) required to run the server. This also sets the server name. A Plutonium account must be at least one week old to create a key, and game ownership must be [verified](https://forum.plutonium.pw/topic/32250/an-update-on-game-ownership-verification)

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Map Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to enable map rotation (the Map Rotation List must then also be set) or to load a specific initial map (the Initial Game Type and Initial Map must then also be set, as applicable)

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Configure the map rotation in 'server.cfg' or 'server_zm.cfg' (as applicable)

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Type (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type to start the server with in Multiplayer mode. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured. Settings for each game type can be set in 'server.cfg'

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. See 'server.cfg' or 'server_zm.cfg' (as applicable) for map names. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured

configurationFields.label: Load Mod
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod to load when starting the server, based on the path to the mod in the 'Plutonium/storage/t4' directory

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time. Maximum 64 for Multiplayer, 4 for Zombies

configurationFields.label: Private Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of private players allowed on the server (those that can use non-public reserved slots). Will be limited to the Player Limit

configurationFields.label: Private Player Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for private players to join the server. Private players entering this password have access to all slots on the server, otherwise the players only have access to the public slots (Player Limit less Private Player Limit)

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be prevented from loading files not on the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum Bandwidth
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum bandwidth for the server

configurationFields.label: Temporary Ban Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time for a player temporary ban (on kick/tempban)

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server And Web
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, etc) from either the server or the web

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Web
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, etc) from [the web](https://plutonium.pw/docs/server/t4/fastdl/). Requires the Fast Download URL to be set

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the base URL for download redirection. Must be HTTP only

configurationFields.label: Treat As Disconnected While Downloading
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be treated as disconnected while downloading from the web

configurationFields.label: RCON Rate Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON rate limit (per IP)

configurationFields.label: Enable Server Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, server voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Server Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice quality level

configurationFields.label: Enable Global Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, global voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Talking Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the voice chat talking duration

configurationFields.label: Enable Dead Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, dead players will be allowed to use voice chat to communicate with living players

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat Local Echo
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat local echo be enabled

configurationFields.label: Spectating Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the type of spectating allowed in the game

configurationFields.label: Gravity
configurationFields.description: Sets the gravity in the game world

configurationFields.label: Player Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the movement speed of players

configurationFields.label: Team Affects Bullet Penetration
configurationFields.description: If set, teammates' bodies will affect bullet penetration

configurationFields.label: Allow Rocket Jumps
configurationFields.description: If enabled, rocket jumps will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Client-Side Features
configurationFields.description: If set, allows various client-side features to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Client-Side Bullets
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will handle bullet holes and tracers. Requires Client-Side Features to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Client-Side Vehicles
configurationFields.description: If set, vehicles will be predicted on the client, reducing response time. Requires Client-Side Features to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Client Archive (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will archive data to save bandwidth on the server. Requires Client-Side Features to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Client-Side Lights (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will handle lighting. Requires Client-Side Features to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, voting will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Abstain Vote Weight (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the weight of abstain votes in voting

configurationFields.label: Enable Killcam (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, the killcam feature will be enabled, which shows how a player was killed

configurationFields.label: Enable Team Balancing (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, team balancing will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Dropped Weapons (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of guns allowed to drop in the game. Change to 16 if a higher value causes issues

configurationFields.label: Fix Bullet Damage Duplication (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, clipping players won't receive duplicate damage

configurationFields.label: Minimum Starting Players (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum players needed to start the game. Do NOT set this higher than the Player Limit!

configurationFields.label: Enable Dead Text Chat (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, dead players will be allowed to use text chat to communicate with living players

configurationFields.label: Enhance Weapon Rate (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, Double Tap 2.0 will be enabled, enhancing both the rate of fire of weapons and the number of bullets per shot

deploymentSteps.name: Disable Prefix Sound
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && wget -q -N https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x winetricks; export WINEPREFIX=\"{SERVER_DIR}/.wine\"; export WINEARCH=win32; ./winetricks sound=disabled > winescript_log.txt 2>&1"

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
